body:
There was no valid end-to-end latency baseline for the first-session machine task. Add a bounded live verifier for Meet BASIC unit 1, measuring five sequential fresh-context cold starts, five same-page unchanged runs and five edited greetings.

Timing starts at the Run click event and ends only after fresh complete ROM output, successful completion, two animation-frame callbacks and nonblank canvas readback. Edited runs also retain source-input-event to result. A missing expected result fails without producing a latency. Retain individual observations, network/cache records, source/runtime hashes and ranges/medians; no product optimisation or performance budget is introduced.

Live Chrome results: cold 3.43–3.74s, warm unchanged 3.31–3.44s, warm edited 3.23–3.37s. Five trials per group on one unthrottled M2 Max desktop; cold means cache-disabled fresh context, warm means module reuse on the same page. No first-pixel, Core Web Vitals, mobile, learner or causal speedup claim. Companion docs retain exact boundaries and observation overhead.

Validation: 15 complete machine outcomes, deliberate missing-result failure, independent statistics and five rejected corrupted-evidence controls; node --check, zero inserted semicolons and git diff --check pass. Uses existing dependencies only.

Fixes #748 when the companion evidence is accepted. Umbrella #124 remains open.

Companion evidence: https://github.com/code198x/docs/pull/82 .
title: Measure complete first-session BASIC outcomes across cold and warm runs
